name: alphonse-studio
title_zh: 33 个技能打包成一套，按场景挑着用
tagline_zh: 不用挨个搜、挨个试装。装一个合集，写作、编程、办公、生活四类场景各就各位，省下的是你翻仓库的时间。
tagline_en: Stop hunting skills one by one. One install covers writing, coding, office, and life—each filed under the scene.
why_zh: 它把散装技能按用途分好了层，装完像进了工具间，要什么直接拿，不用记每个技能叫什么名。
why_en: It organizes scattered skills by job, so after install you're in a tidy toolbox—grab what fits, no need to memorize names.
limit_zh: 合集只做收纳与分发，不保证每个技能都适配你的工作流；个别技能可能依赖特定 API 或本地环境。
limit_en: This pack only organizes and distributes; it doesn't guarantee every skill fits your workflow. Some may need specific APIs or local setup—test after.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 33 skills in one pack, pick by scenario
